answer: Resist sybils with verifiable execution-trace attestation: each identity must attach signed runtime traces proving it actually ran the work it claims - inputs, outputs and timing sealed by its executor. A terrace of standing grows only from traces peers can replay and check. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes cannot reuse one trace: each vine of copied logs is exposed by freshness nonces, and every sybil must genuinely execute its own workload, turning free names into linear compute, while an honest agent traces one ember-warm job cheaply.
